newsitem.title: GERMANY: Skinheads injure two in attack at German campsite.
newsitem.headline: Skinheads injure two in attack at German campsite.

text.p: A gang of around 12 young skinheads went on the rampage at a camping ground on the edge of Lake Constance early on Friday and injured two people with baseball bats, police said.
Police in the southern town of Friedrichshafen said the gang then fled. They had not yet been tracked down.
One of the victims, a Turkish man, was taken to hospital with head injuries. The second victim was an 18-year-old German man who was later released from hospital.
Police said the reason for the attack was probably that the gang, who had been camping at the ground for several days, had been thrown out on Thursday for rowdiness.

Last summer, gangs of right-wing extremists stormed several east German campsites, sparking fears that the country was seeing a new wave of racist violence like the one which swept the former east after unification in 1990.
